ei.title: Why Experts Struggle to Teach Novices
ei.subject: 올림포스전국연합고1_2026

fullPassage: A number of research studies have shown how experts in a field often experience difficulties when introducing newcomers to that field. For example, in a genuine training situation, Dr Pamela Hinds found that people expert in using mobile phones were remarkably less accurate than novice phone users in judging how long it takes people to learn to use the phones. Experts can become insensitive to how hard a task is for the beginner, an effect referred to as the 'curse of knowledge'. Dr Hinds was able to show that as people acquired the skill, they then began to underestimate the level of difficulty of that skill. Her participants even underestimated how long it had taken themselves to acquire that skill in an earlier session. Knowing that experts forget how hard it was for them to learn, we can understand the need to look at the learning process through students' eyes, rather than making assumptions about how students 'should be' learning.

✅ ② less accurate than novice phone users(초보 사용자보다 덜 정확한): 전문가가 학습 시간을 판단할 때 초보자보다 덜 정확했다 ← 정답

❌ ③ faster than any machine available then(당시 어떤 기계보다 빠른): 본문 근거 없음

❌ ④ better trained than the whole research team(연구팀 전체보다 더 훈련된): 본문 근거 없음
det.tip: remarkably less accurate than novice = 초보자보다 현저히 덜 정확한

questions.passage: A number of research studies have shown how experts in a field often experience difficulties when introducing newcomers to that field. For example, in a genuine training situation, Dr Pamela Hinds found that people expert in using mobile phones were remarkably less accurate than novice phone users in judging how long it takes people to learn to use the phones. Experts can become insensitive to how hard a task is for the beginner, an effect referred to as the 'curse of knowledge'. Dr Hinds was able to show that as people acquired the skill, they then began to underestimate the level of difficulty of that skill. Her participants even underestimated how long it had taken themselves to acquire that skill in an earlier session. Knowing that experts __________, we can understand the need to look at the learning process through students' eyes, rather than making assumptions about how students 'should be' learning.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빈칸: forget how hard it was for them to learn(배우기가 얼마나 어려웠는지 잊는다)
det.analysis:
✅ ① forget how hard it was for them to learn(배우기가 얼마나 어려웠는지 잊는다): 전문가가 자신의 학습 고충을 잊기에 학생 눈높이로 볼 필요가 있다 ← 정답

❌ ② remember every struggle they once faced(겪었던 모든 고충을 기억한다): 글의 논지와 반대

❌ ③ enjoy teaching beginners far more than experts(전문가보다 초보 가르치기를 즐긴다): 본문 근거 없음

❌ ④ refuse to share their knowledge with others(지식 공유를 거부한다): 본문 근거 없음
det.tip: Knowing that experts ____ = 전문가가 학습의 어려움을 잊는다는 점을 알기에
